about: One item per task row of the WORK BREAKDOWN table of each measured job: Outcome, Evidence and Owns, verbatim. The Skills and Open when columns are not here.

items.outcome: Assumptions 1 and 2 proved or disproved. (1) FTS5 is compiled into the bundled SQLite that `rusqlite` builds. (2) A skill whose header has nested maps under `metadata` (shape of spec section 7.1) passes `rex skills check`, and Claude Code loads it with no warning.
items.evidence: `cargo test` passes, including a new Rust test in `tests/integration/` that creates an FTS5 virtual table (columns name, card, intents), runs a query ranked by `bm25(t, 4.0, 2.0, 3.0)`, and asserts an order that the column weights decide. A test that runs the built `rex skills check` on the metadata fixture and asserts exit 0. Live load, with a positive control: the same commands (`claude plugin validate <dir>`, `claude plugin details <dir>`, and one headless run with `--debug` or `--output-format stream-json`, quoting the init event and each debug line about the skill) on three fixtures: (1) the metadata fixture, (2) the same skill with no `metadata` as a baseline, (3) a skill with a broken header (for example YAML indented with tabs), which must show a warning. The metadata fixture is loaded from a plugin's `skills/` folder and also from a project `.claude/skills/` folder. Output file: one block per assumption with verdict `PASSED`, `FAILED`, `NOT EXERCISED` or `READ ONLY`.
items.owns: `tests/integration/main.rs` (one `mod` line only), one new test module below `tests/integration/`, new fixture folder `tests/fixtures/wp0-metadata/` (fixture skills, throwaway plugin and project folder for the live load, runner)

items.outcome: Assumption 3 proved or disproved: an MCP server that a plugin's own manifest lists can be called from that plugin's mod with `$.mcp.call` (a) from the main session, (b) from a sub-agent's tool call, (c) from a builder that a master started. The exact manifest key that declares an MCP server confirmed.
items.evidence: Throwaway plugin in the fixture folder: manifest that lists a stub stdio MCP server (TypeScript run by `node` 24 with type stripping, built-ins only, no new dependency), a mod that registers one probe tool whose handler calls `$.mcp.call` on the stub and wraps its answer in a fixed marker, and a runner in TypeScript run by `node`. The runner makes a new random nonce for each run; the stub returns the nonce and appends each call it gets to a log file in the temp folder. Nested sessions allow only the probe tool (`mcp__<fixture plugin>__<probe>`) plus `Agent` for (b) and (c), and disallow each stub tool (`--disallowedTools 'mcp__<stub>__*'`). Quote the marker, the nonce and the log line for each of (a), (b), (c), or verdict `NOT EXERCISED` with cause. `tsc -p tests/fixtures/wp0-mcp/<plugin>/tsconfig.json` passes (that tsconfig extends `plugin/tsconfig.json` and includes `typings/claude-code`). Manifest key: URL and quoted text of the MCP servers section of https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference (read with WebFetch), plus file and line of `typings/claude-code/index.d.ts`. IF `claude plugin validate` accepts the fixture manifest with that key AND the stub run connects, THEN the key verdict is `PASSED`; ELSE `READ ONLY`. Output file: one block per assumption and one for the key.

items.outcome: `rex skills check` reads the `metadata` map of spec 7.1 (`src/commands/skills/header.rs`) and applies new rules with permanent IDs (for example `M1`, `M2`, ...): (1) the section 10 checks: `kind` and `category` present and vocabulary terms; every claim term, and every scope key and closed-list value, in the vocabulary; every file in the skill folder (not only Markdown) listed in `files`, and every listed file exists; every `open_when`, `requires`, `replaces` target exists; `not_when` present when `scope` is present; (2) the field rules of the 7.1 table, each as a finding, never a panic: a key under `claims` or `scope` that 7.1 or the vocabulary does not name; a value of the wrong YAML type; `kind` not exactly one of the four; `placement` not `full` or `open-when`; a `files` item with no `path`, a `role` not `topic`, `language` or `code`, or a `language` or `code` file with no `language`; `SKILL.md` listed in `files`; `intents` not 3 to 5 strings; `not_when` not one line; `max_topics` not a positive whole number. A skill with no `metadata`, or whose `metadata` holds no key of 7.1 (for example only `author`), is valid and gets no new finding. Other keys under `metadata` are ignored, because Claude Code treats `metadata` as free-form. The vocabulary of T1 is embedded in the binary. A clear, marked place is left for the intent-phrase check (WP4); no `metadata` size limit (Q9). H1 to H9 and B1 to B5 stay unchanged.

items.outcome: `rex skills serve [--library <path>]...` runs a hand-written stdio JSON-RPC MCP server (no new crate). Answers `initialize`, `tools/list` (three tools `head`, `search`, `get` with spec 8.2 input schemas), `tools/call`. `head` = `protocol` "skills/1", `library`, `version`, `skills`, `vocabulary`; `version` = SHA-256 of sorted (relative path, file SHA-256) pairs of every served skill file + vocabulary version. `get` = `skill`, `file`, `sha256`, `text`; `isError` code `not_found` for missing skill/file or path that leaves skill folder; skill name `^[a-z0-9-]+$`. `search` = `isError` code `not_implemented` from one replaceable function. Several `--library` in priority order, first wins on same skill name (whole skill). No `--library` = embedded library of `src/bundle.rs` (`plugin/library`, 24 skills). Vocabulary version read by one small function from `vocab/terms.json` beside the served library folder; absent = `"vocabulary": null` + empty vocabulary version in hash.
items.evidence: `cargo build`, `cargo test`, `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and `cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` exit 0, output quoted. New tests in `tests/integration/skills_serve/` start `rex skills serve --library <fixture>` as child process, speak JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout, and show: (1) initialize + tools/list answer and list three tools; (2) head answers five fields; (3) same `version` on two runs, different after one byte of one file changes; (4) `get` text SHA-256 = its `sha256`; (5) `get` missing skill, missing file, `..` path, absolute `file` (`/etc/hosts`), `file` = `sub/../../other-skill/SKILL.md`, and skill names `../x` and `A` each = `not_found`; (6) a fixture symlink inside a skill folder to a sentinel file outside the library = `not_found`, and the sentinel text is in no answer; (7) `search` = `not_implemented`; (8) two `--library` folders with same skill name: `get` gives first, and a file that only the second folder's copy holds = `not_found`; (9) `--library <missing>` exits non-zero, one `error:` line on stderr, nothing on stdout; (10) no `--library`: head reports embedded library with 24 skills; (11) copy of `plugin/library` in a temp folder with no `vocab/` beside it, plus a `.DS_Store` in one skill: `head.version` = the version that no `--library` gives; (12) `<tmp>/vocab/terms.json` `{"version":"1"}` beside `<tmp>/lib`: head answers `"vocabulary": "1"` and a `version` that differs from the same `lib` with no vocab file; (13) an invalid terms.json gives the answer that T1's failure table fixes, tested. Report quotes test output + names the vocabulary field read.
